results.question: Members 상위 1% 작품의 장르 분포 vs 전체 작품의 장르 분포
results.generated_sql:
WITH total_genres AS (
    SELECT 
        genre, 
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS global_pct
    FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance, UNNEST(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    GROUP BY 1
),
top_genres AS (
    SELECT 
        genre, 
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS top_pct
    FROM (
        SELECT genres 
        FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance 
        ORDER BY members DESC 
        LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(*) / 100 FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance)
    ), UNNEST(string_split(genres, ', ')) AS genre
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    t.genre, 
    COALESCE(t.top_pct, 0) AS top_1_percent_distribution, 
    COALESCE(g.global_pct, 0) AS global_distribution
FROM total_genres g
FULL OUTER JOIN top_genres t ON g.genre = t.genre
ORDER BY top_1_percent_distribution DESC;

results.question: 시즌별(Winter/Spring/Summer/Fall) 평균 점수와 작품 수 비교
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    season, 
    AVG(mal_score) AS avg_mal_score, 
    COUNT(anime_id) AS anime_count 
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance 
GROUP BY season;

results.question: 연도별 평균 드롭률의 변화 추이
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  start_year,
  AVG(drop_rate) AS avg_drop_rate
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY start_year
ORDER BY start_year;

results.question: 스튜디오별 평균 점수 상위 10개 (최소 20작품 이상)
results.generated_sql:
SELECT studios, AVG(mal_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS anime_count
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
GROUP BY studios
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.question: Action 장르와 Romance 장르의 평균 점수, 완주율, Members 비교
2000년대(2000-2009) vs 2010년대(2010-2019) 작품의 평균 드롭률과 완주율 변화
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 THEN '2000s'
    WHEN start_year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2019 THEN '2010s'
  END AS decade,
  AVG(drop_rate) AS avg_drop_rate,
  AVG(completion_rate) AS avg_completion_rate
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
WHERE start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2019
GROUP BY 1;

results.question: Manga 원작 애니메이션 vs Light Novel 원작 vs Original의 성과 비교 (점수, 완주율, Members)
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    source_material, 
    AVG(mal_score) AS avg_mal_score, 
    AVG(completion_rate) AS avg_completion_rate, 
    AVG(members) AS avg_members 
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance

results.question: 에피소드 수 구간별(1화, 2-12화, 13-26화, 27-52화, 52화+) 평균 점수와 완주율
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN episodes = 1 THEN '1화'
    WHEN episodes BETWEEN 2 AND 12 THEN '2-12화'
    WHEN episodes BETWEEN 13 AND 26 THEN '13-26화'
    WHEN episodes BETWEEN 27 AND 52 THEN '27-52화'
    ELSE '52화+'
  END AS episode_range,
  AVG(mal_score) AS avg_mal_score,
  AVG(completion_rate) AS avg_completion_rate
FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN episode_range = '1화' THEN 1
    WHEN episode_range = '2-12화' THEN 2
    WHEN episode_range = '13-26화' THEN 3
    WHEN episode_range = '27-52화' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END;

results.question: Members 상위 1% 작품의 장르 분포 vs 전체 작품의 장르 분포
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  genre,
  COUNT(*) AS total_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN members_tier = 'Top 1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_1_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS total_distribution_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN members_tier = 'Top 1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN members_tier = 'Top 1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER (), 2) AS top_1_distribution_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    anime_id,
    members_tier,
    trim(unnest(string_split(genres, ','))) AS genre
  FROM main_marts.mart_content_performance
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY top_1_distribution_pct DESC;
